en: n. a long warm coat worn over other clothes in cold weather
ex: He wore a heavy overcoat to keep warm in winter.
他冬天穿一件厚重的大衣保暖。

en: vt. to fail to see or notice something; to choose to ignore something; to have a view of something from above; n. a high place from which you can see a wide area
ex: The hotel room overlooks the sea.
這間旅館房間俯瞰著大海。

en: adv. during the night; suddenly or very quickly; a. lasting through the night; happening very quickly; n. a stay for one night
ex: The package will be delivered overnight.
包裹將會隔夜送達。

en: vt. to remove a government or ruler from power by force; to cause something to fall; n. the removal of a leader or government from power by force
ex: The army tried to overthrow the government.
軍隊企圖推翻政府。

en: n. the speed at which someone or something moves or develops; a single step when walking; vi. to walk slowly backwards and forwards; vt. to measure a distance by taking steps
ex: He walked at a slow pace along the beach.
他沿著海灘慢慢走。

en: n. a large piece of cloth that opens in the air to help someone fall slowly from a plane; vi. to jump from an aircraft using a parachute; vt. to drop people or goods by parachute
ex: The pilot jumped out with a parachute when the plane caught fire.
飛機起火時，飛行員用降落傘跳了出去。

en: n. a business relationship in which two or more people share the profits and the risks; a relationship between two groups who work together; a close working relationship
ex: The two companies formed a partnership to develop new software.
兩家公司結為夥伴開發新軟體。

en: a. not taking action to change or control things; accepting what happens without complaining; (in grammar) a verb form where the subject receives the action; not producing electricity
ex: He plays a passive role in the discussion.
他在討論中扮演被動的角色。

en: n. a food made from flour and water in various shapes, such as spaghetti and macaroni, which is boiled and eaten with sauce
ex: We had pasta with tomato sauce for dinner.
我們晚餐吃了番茄醬義大利麵。

en: n. the soft foot of an animal such as a cat or dog; v. to touch or scratch something with the foot; to touch someone in an unpleasant way; (of a horse) to scrape the ground with a hoof
ex: The dog gave me its paw to shake.
那隻狗伸出爪子跟我握手。

en: n. a quick or secret look; a quiet, high sound like that of a young bird; vi. to look quickly and secretly at something; to appear slowly from behind something; to make a high sound like a young bird
ex: She took a peep through the keyhole.
她從鑰匙孔偷看了一眼。

en: n. a punishment for breaking a rule or law; a disadvantage that results from doing something; (in sports) an advantage given to the other team when a rule is broken; a free shot in soccer
ex: The penalty for speeding is a heavy fine.
超速的處罰是一大筆罰款。

en: n. a number or amount expressed as a fraction of one hundred; (part of) a hundred
ex: About fifty percent of the students passed the test.
大約百分之五十的學生通過了考試。

en: n. a liquid with a pleasant smell that you put on your skin; a pleasant smell; vt. to put perfume on something; to make something smell nice
ex: She wore a light floral perfume.
她擦了淡淡的花香香水。

en: a. lasting for a long time or forever; not likely to change; (of a job) having no limit on how long it lasts; n. a hairstyle with waves or curls that lasts for months
ex: He has found a permanent job at a bank.
他在銀行找到了一份長期工作。

en: a. expecting bad things to happen; always thinking that the worst will happen; believing that life is bad
ex: He is pessimistic about his chances of winning.
他對自己獲勝的機會很悲觀。

en: n. the study of the meaning of life and the nature of knowledge; a set of ideas or beliefs about how to live; a person's attitude to life; the basic ideas of a subject
ex: She studied philosophy and religion at university.
她在大學主修哲學與宗教。

en: n. a doctor, especially one who treats illnesses with medicine and not by surgery; a person who gives relief or comfort
ex: The physician examined the patient carefully.
醫師仔細檢查了病人。

en: n. the science that deals with matter, energy, motion and force; the physical properties of something; the study of the laws of nature
ex: He is studying physics at university.
他在大學念物理。

en: n. a small round fruit with smooth purple, red or yellow skin and a large seed inside; the tree that bears this fruit; the dark purple color of this fruit
ex: She made a jar of plum jam from fresh fruit.
她用新鮮水果做了一罐李子果醬。

en: n. a person whose job is to fit and repair water pipes, bathtubs and toilets
ex: We called a plumber to fix the leaking pipe.
我們叫水電工來修漏水的管子。

en: a. containing poison that can kill or harm you; (of a person or remark) very unpleasant and hurtful; (of an animal) able to produce poison
ex: Some mushrooms in the forest are poisonous.
森林裡有些蘑菇有毒。

en: vt. to make something shiny by rubbing it; to improve something by making small changes; n. a substance used to make something shiny; a shiny surface; a. (Polish) relating to Poland
ex: He polishes his shoes every morning.
他每天早上都擦鞋。

en: vt. to have or own something; to have a particular quality or ability; to control someone's thoughts or behavior; (of a spirit) to take control of someone's mind
ex: She possesses a rare talent for music.
她擁有罕見的音樂天賦。

en: n. the state of owning something; something that you own; (plural) things that someone owns; a territory controlled by another country; (of a spirit) the state of being controlled by something
ex: The police arrested him for possession of illegal drugs.
警方以持有非法毒品逮捕了他。

en: n. a statement about what will happen in the future; the act of saying what you think will happen; a forecast
ex: His prediction about the election result turned out to be correct.
他對選舉結果的預測最後是對的。

en: n. the state of having a baby growing inside the body; the period of time during which a woman is pregnant; meaningful quality
ex: She learned of her pregnancy last week.
她上週得知自己懷孕了。

en: n. a formal talk in which someone shows or explains something to a group; the way in which something is shown or described; the act of giving something to someone officially; the way in which food is displayed
ex: She gave a presentation on climate change to the class.
她對全班發表了一場關於氣候變遷的簡報。

en: vt. to keep something in its present state; to protect something from harm; to treat food so that it can be kept for a long time; n. fruit boiled with sugar to keep it for a long time; an area set apart for wildlife
ex: We must preserve our natural resources for future generations.
我們必須為後代保存自然資源。

en: n. something that is more important than other things and needs to be dealt with first; the right to go before other people; the state of being more important
ex: Safety is our top priority.
安全是我們的首要之務。

en: n. a special right or advantage that only one person or group has; a good opportunity that makes you feel happy and proud; a right granted to someone; vt. to give someone a special right or benefit
ex: It was a great privilege to meet the president.
能與總統見面是莫大的榮幸。

en: n. a way of doing something, especially the correct or usual way; a series of actions that must be taken to complete something; a formal way of doing things such as in a court of law
ex: The surgeon explained the procedure to the patient.
外科醫生向病人說明了手術流程。

en: vi. to continue to do something that has already been started; to go forward; to start doing something; to take legal action against someone; (formal) to come from a particular source
ex: Please proceed to Gate 12 for boarding.
請前往 12 號登機門登機。

en: a. showing signs of future success; likely to be good or successful; giving a reason to hope
ex: She is a promising young writer with a bright future.
她是個有光明前途的有為年輕作家。

en: a. done quickly and without delay; arriving on time; vt. to cause someone to do something; to remind someone of the words to say; n. a reminder or signal that prompts someone to act; a message on a computer screen asking the user to do something
ex: We appreciate your prompt reply to our email.
感謝你迅速回覆我們的電子郵件。

en: n. the way in which a word is said; the way in which someone says words; the sounds of a language
ex: My English teacher helped me improve my pronunciation.
我的英文老師幫助我改善發音。

en: n. a plan or suggestion that is put forward for people to consider; an offer of marriage; an official suggestion for changing a law or policy
ex: The committee approved the budget proposal.
委員會通過了預算提案。

en: vi. to be successful and make a lot of money; to grow well and be healthy; to become rich; vt. to make someone successful
ex: The business began to prosper after they moved to the city.
搬到城市後，他們的生意開始興旺。

en: n. the state of being successful and having a lot of money; a time of economic success; good fortune
ex: The country enjoyed a period of peace and prosperity.
這個國家經歷了一段和平與繁榮的時期。

en: a. having a lot of money and success; economically successful; (of a place or a business) doing very well
ex: The family lived in a prosperous neighborhood.
這個家庭住在富裕的社區。
